DESCRIPTION:
Propose a local or external asset to the catalog through a pull request

USAGE:
    agentpack submit <kind> <path-or-url-or-id> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack submit skill ./my-skill
    agentpack submit hook ./check.sh --trigger preToolUse
    agentpack submit mcp github --command github-mcp-server --env GITHUB_TOKEN
    agentpack submit skill https://github.com/acme/skills/tree/main/my-skill
    agentpack submit skill ./my-skill --update

ARGUMENTS:
    <kind>                 Asset kind, for example skill, hook, mcp, prompt,    
                           agent, or tool                                       
    <path-or-url-or-id>    Local file/folder, external git URL, or the id of an 
                           MCP server                                           

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
        --id <ID>                    Catalog id. Default: derived from the file,
                                     folder, or URL                             
        --name <NAME>                Display name. Default: the id in title case
        --description <TEXT>         One line telling a reader when to use this 
                                     asset                                      
        --version <VERSION>          Catalog asset version. Default: 1.0.0 for a
                                     new asset, the next patch when updating    
        --ref <REF>                  Specific external commit or immutable tag. 
                                     Omit to pin the latest current commit      
    -g, --group <GROUP>              Catalog groups this asset belongs to       
                                     (repeatable or comma-separated)            
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>        Limit to specific providers. Omit for all  
                                     providers (the default)                    
        --license <LICENSE>          SPDX license identifier for an external

DESCRIPTION:
Install catalog assets into your user profile or current project

USAGE:
    agentpack install [targets] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack install
    agentpack install code-review --codex --user

ARGUMENTS:
    [targets]    Optional kind (skills, hooks, mcp, ...) followed by asset ids. 
                 Empty = interactive selection                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --user                   Operate on user scope (your home directory)    
                                 instead of the project                         
        --project                Operate on project scope (the current          
                                 repository)                                    
        --claude                 Target Claude Code                             
        --codex                  Target Codex                                   
        --copilot                Target GitHub Copilot                          
        --cursor                 Target Cursor                                  
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>    Target providers by name (repeatable or        
                                 comma-separated)                               
    -y, --yes                    Skip confirmation prompts (for scripts and CI) 
        --force                  Overwrite locally modified installs without    
                                 asking                                         
        --keep-local             Keep locally modified installs without asking  
    -g, --group <GROUP>          Install everything in a group (repeatable or   
                                 comma-separated)                               
        --dry-run                Show the install plan without changing provider
                                 files
